usedFor: Kommo holds your incoming leads, and GorillaDesk receives them through “Add a Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Kommo, then “Add a Lead” in GorillaDesk
bestTemplate.why: A lead captured in Kommo is added to GorillaDesk, so the field service team sees it too.

watchOut: “New Lead” also feeds “Add a Customer”, so pick lead or customer, not both, or one person appears twice.
